component.name: FatRat
component.summary: Download manager for HTTP, FTP and BitTorrent

description.p: FatRat downloads over HTTP(S), FTP(S) and BitTorrent, keeps your transfers in queues, follows RSS feeds and runs on a schedule. You can drive it from the desktop app, a web browser, a terminal or a script, all at the same time.

ul.li: Segmented HTTP and FTP downloads with mirror lists, Metalink and resume
BitTorrent with magnet links, DHT, per-file priorities and torrent creation
Queues with their own directories, speed limits and limits on running transfers
RSS rules and TV episode tracking
Scheduler that starts, stops and throttles queues at set times
Clipboard monitor, drop box and FTP uploads
Web interface, terminal UI and REST API for remote use

description.p: Fixes the build with libtorrent-rasterbar 2.1 and passes the proxy password to libtorrent.
Ported to Qt 6, with a new web interface, a terminal UI, a REST API and Python extensions.
